content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Scientific Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position at IIT Roorkee is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech. degree in Engineering/Technology in a relevant discipline, along with relevant experience, to be eligible for the Scientific Administrative Assistant role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post will receive a salary of Rs. 24000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Roorkee Scientific Administrative Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you follow the application procedure outlined in the official notification and send your application before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification indicates that there is no application fee for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Scientific Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position at IIT Roorkee will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Scientific Administrative Assistant position at IIT Roorkee is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.
